name: app-instances
title: App Instances
description: Show and switch between all open instances and windows of an application.
author: developer

commands.name: index
commands.title: Show App Instances
commands.subtitle: Window & Instance Switcher
commands.description: Lists all open windows and instances across running applications.

scripts.build:helper: SDK_PATH=$(/usr/bin/xcrun --show-sdk-path) && /usr/bin/clang -target arm64-apple-macos11 -isysroot "$SDK_PATH" -framework Cocoa -framework ApplicationServices -O3 native/window-helper.m -o /tmp/wh-arm64 && /usr/bin/clang -target x86_64-apple-macos11 -isysroot "$SDK_PATH" -framework Cocoa -framework ApplicationServices -O3 native/window-helper.m -o /tmp/wh-x86_64 && /usr/bin/lipo -create -output assets/window-helper /tmp/wh-arm64 /tmp/wh-x86_64 && rm -f /tmp/wh-arm64 /tmp/wh-x86_64 && chmod +x assets/window-helper
scripts.build: npm run build:helper && ray build -e dist -o dist
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, consider removing the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\`.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
